guide.title: How to use VisitedCountries?
guide.step.map: Click a country on the map to mark it as visited. Click it again to remove it.
guide.step.list: In the list, type a country name in the search field and the lists are filtered right away. Add a country with the plus next to its name.
guide.step.date: When adding a country you can set the month and year of your visit. “This year” stats are based on it.
guide.step.settings: Change the theme and language in Settings, and your details and password in your Profile.
guide.contact: Have a question or something doesn't work? Write to us.
visit.date.title: When did you visit this country?
visit.date.description: The date is optional. It's used for the “This year” stats.
stats.title: Statistics
news.title: What's new
news.hint: Click a notification to mark it as read.
favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.empty: You have no favorite countries yet. Add them with the heart next to a country in the list or by clicking a country on the map.
guide.step.tooltip: Hover over a country on the map to see its name.
guide.step.favorites: Add countries you want to visit to favorites with the heart in the list or in the window after clicking a country on the map. Find them under the heart in the top bar (in the bottom menu on phones), where you can also mark them as visited. Once visited, a country is removed from favorites.
guide.step.news: Find what's new under the bell. Click a notification to mark it as read.
guide.step.edit.date: Change a visit date with the pencil next to a country in the visited list.
